column1: # Rules marked IGNORE are documented false positives.
# Rules marked FAIL will cause the CI job to fail.
# Rules not listed here use the ZAP default (WARN).
# These headers are enforced in next.config.ts (see apps/web/next.config.ts,
# securityHeaders) and must be present in production responses. Missing-header
# findings are treated as failures so the ZAP scan only passes when all OWASP
# 10038 Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set
# 10036 Server Leaks Version Information via "Server" HTTP Response Header
# 10037 Server Leaks Information via "X-Powered-By" HTTP Response Header
# 10039 Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set (Deprecated)
#   False positive: Supabase auth cookies are set with SameSite=Lax server-side;
#   ZAP does not authenticate and sees only anonymous session cookies.
